text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Friday.
- At a press conference in Vukovar UNTAES annouced the withdrawal of its military component in July.
- U.N. transitional administrator Jacques Klein is claiming that all the culprits of mass murders in Ovcara will be captured.
- National Bank Governor, Marko Skreb voted the "governor of the year" by the Central European magazine.
- The Croatian Danube region is ready for elections, says in an interview, Ivan Mrkonjic the president of the electoral comission.
- Croatian government pledges to take steps to lower the cost of housebuilding.
- A Word Bank loan enables the purchasing of three fire-fighting planes and 30 water tankers ensuring the fire protection of the coast.

- The government adopts the proposal for the dividing the telecommunications from postal services in line with international trends. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075 -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
